series.label: Coal production · Billion Btu
series.definition: Coal production. Exact retained EIA SEDS series CLPRB; one 2024F release, source observations 2000–2024.

sources.title: U.S. Energy Information Administration, State Energy Data System 2024F final cycle
sources.license: EIA public-domain government data; attribution requested

limitations: EIA SEDS estimates from one retained 2024F release; final identifies the release cycle, not measurement certainty.
Each source code, commodity form, unit and energy-accounting boundary is separate. Do not add production, transformation, electricity sales, or component and total series together.
Energy-content units are not physical mass or volume. Physical and Btu variants are parallel source views, not additional output to sum.
State totals do not locate a mine, power plant, refinery, company owner or individual household. National and federal-offshore rows are retained separately, never allocated to states.
Missing source rows or nonnumeric source cells remain unavailable; no annual interpolation, carry-forward, zero filling, or cross-unit conversion is performed.
The selected analysis window is 2000–2024; the complete retained source has earlier years. Later preliminary releases are not merged with this vintage.
series.reporting_period: Calendar year; frozen EIA 2024F release cycle
